text.description_html:
RK International CK-308, White Porcelain Knob with Polished Brass Base

If all that is gold glitters and all that is porcelain shines, then the White Porcelain Ball Cabinet Knob with Polished Brass Rose is sure to catch eyes. The color white is coming back into the design world in a big way. People love its clean look and the brightness it can add to a space. The polished brass base adds a subtle retro feel. This look has endured the test of time with gaining popularity. The porcelain cabinet knob with base is available in two sizes: a 1 inch diameter and a 1-1/4 inch diameter.

Also Available Matching: White Porcelain Ball Cabinet Knob with Polished Chrome Rose

Specifications and Features of the RK International CK-308 White Porcelain Cabinet Knob:

  • Material: porcelain with some brass
  • Porcelain Color: White
  • Base Finish: Polished Brass
  • Screw: 1" long #8 - 32 machine screw.
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Available in 2 Sizes

    RKI-CK-308:
    • Diameter: 1"
    • Projection: 1-3/8"

    RKI-CK-304:
    • Diameter: 1-1/4"
    • Projection: 1-5/8"

Sold Individually
